copy.headline: Horned Frogs Fall to Blue Jays, 95-87
copy.caption: Trailing by nine at the half, TCU fought back in the second half before dropping its first game at the Players Era Tournament on Thursday, 95-87, to Creighton at T-Mobile Arena.

story.title: Horned Frogs Fall to Blue Jays, 95-87
story.summary: LAS VEGAS – Trailing by nine at the half, TCU fought back in the second half before dropping its first game at the Players Era Tournament on Thursday, 95-87, to Creighton at T-Mobile Arena.
